text:
incident-bot: [PAGER] High GPU allocation failures in asia-east4 — autoscaler pending-claims growing, queue_len major spike, some customer requests seeing 503s. Escalate to oncall.
alex: seeing sustained `RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED` from GCP when trying to create GPU nodes. Alloc rate ~0.25/s, backlog ~950. Warm pool is empty.
priya: confirmed. warm-pool-asia-east4=0, warmpool-autoscale not launching due to quota deny. Logs show repeated `quotaExceeded` on `accelerator` resources.
mike: is this limited to N1/GPU or also A2? I see allocation attempts for both; GCP is rejecting any new accelerator attach.
alex: mostly A2 requests failing. Preemptible pool also blocked.
lia: customer impact: a few high-throughput tenants reported high tail latency; SLO error budget for embeddings-prod-asia is getting hit. Not yet widespread 100% outage, but growth is rapid.
jordan: @alex can you paste the exact error from the nodepool controller? We need the error for support case.
alex: paste below:
```
E0321 22:04:12 controller.go:215] failed to provision node: api error: googleapi: Error 403: Quota 'GPUS' exceeded. More details: https://console.cloud.google.com/quotas
```
priya: opened a GCP support case: 289312-asia-east4-gpu-quota. Support acknowledged and is checking internal limits, but SLA says multi-hour.
mike: short-term mitigation options: 1) reroute a percentage of traffic to eu-west1 (has spare capacity). 2) decrease per-request concurrency on router to flatten peaks. 3) temporarily drop to smaller model variant for non-critical customers.
lia: I can start a traffic shift. Recommend 25% to eu-west1 initially and monitor error rate.
ops-bot: runbook check: runbook/gpu-quota-exhaustion -> step 2 (open support case) completed. Next step: failover routing and customer comms.
alex: executing `route-manager` to shift 25% now. Command:
```
./route-manager update --from=asia-east4 --to=eu-west1 --percent=25 --dry-run=false
```
mike: lowering router concurrency cap for embeddings-prod to 40 (was 80). Pushing policy change now.
priya: GCP responded: internal quota pool currently at capacity; they suggested regional evictions or quota increase, ETA unknown. They asked for request details and we provided support case id.
jordan: any chance we can reconfigure to use A100 instead of A2 in eu-west1 to reduce node count? That will need model compatibility check.
alex: quick check: models are fine across variants; we can route heavy batches to eu-west1-A100 pool. Will require new container scheduling override, doing it now.
lia: customer comms draft: "We're seeing capacity constraints in asia-east4 impacting low % of requests. Traffic is being shifted and we're investigating with cloud provider. We'll follow up within 2 hours." Approve?
mike: approve. Send to customer-impact channel and post to support dashboard.
ops-bot: metrics alert: queue_len(api-serving) korea-zone spike -> +420% since t0. Latency p99 up 4.2x.
alex: warm-pool creation still failing because quota attach denied. Trying manual create with smaller accelerator count to see if anything gets through: `gcloud compute instances create gpu-test --accelerator type=nvidia-tesla-t4,count=1 ...`
alex: result: got deny as well. GCP logs show per-project accelerator hard limit reached.
priya: support suggests two options: 1) transfer workloads to other regions (we're doing that), 2) request quota increase (multi-hour).
mike: also enabling our config to reduce batch sizes to reduce GPU memory pressure; this will lower throughput but help steady state.
lia: routing change complete: 25% to eu-west1. Watching error budget.
jordan: monitoring shows immediate drop in queue_len in asia-east4 by ~22% and overall 503 rate decreased from 1.3% -> 0.6%.
alex: support case update: they've queued internal escalation to quota engineering; they ask to provide exact timestamps and request IDs. I've dumped the error traces and sent them.
lia: prepping handoff to night oncall @jordan at 23:00 UTC. Jordan will take over if case still open.
jordan: grabbing handoff. steps I need: monitor support case, keep route-manager percentage toggles, scale down concurrency further if required, and prepare customer update once we have ETA.
mike: also note: autoscaler config currently tries to create nodes with `accelerator_count=2`. We can update to `accelerator_count=1` to reduce per-node quota consumption and allow more nodes until quota is increased. Proposing patch now.
alex: applying override: changing nodepool template to `acc_count=1` for pending launches. This may increase number of nodes but each uses fewer GPUs.
ops-bot: action log: route-change, concurrency-cap change, nodepool-override applied. Incident remains P1.
lia: sending updated customer note and flagging high-touch tenants we've observed latency for.
priya: GCP replied: quota increase request acknowledged, tentative approval pending manual review. No firm ETA.
alex: partial relief: we started seeing successful allocations for smaller-acc nodes ~22:45 UTC; pending backlog dropped to ~240.
jordan: night handoff: I'll monitor allocations, support case, and be ready to shift extra traffic overnight if needed. Leaving a follow-up checklist: escalate to account team if no approval in 4 hours, prepare incident postmortem, verify warm-pool warmup once quota resolved.
lia: thanks team — nice quick triage. Marking this thread as ongoing and handing to @jordan for the night shift. :thumbsup:
jordan: acknowledged, taking oncall. I'll post a status update in 30m or on new ETA.
ops-bot: incident status changed -> ongoing -> handoff: jordan."
